offline_tests.source: Node built-in test runner; actual child processes, private files and Git working trees; actual Pair worker bridge with a mock Pi/Fabric/Fovea host

deterministic_native_tests.provider: local deterministic fixture; zero cost; no network

limitations: The native matrix covers five narrow safety/retention scenarios, not the full V1 acceptance ledger.
No paid/live model workflow, terminal UI, real compaction threshold, permission matrix, or cache benchmark was run.
Read-only workers with generic Fabric, nonzero shell auto-spill, and recursive Fabric agents are deliberately unsupported.
Fresh tarball installation/removal and non-macOS native profiles remain unqualified.
